title: A phase-robust finite-mode Morse contract
analyticalQuestion: Does fixed M and Q2<=1/2 provide an arbitrary-phase quantitative Morse package that supports a proof-level family-uniform Coble--He extraction?
supportedTakeaway: For fixed M, Q2<=1/2 localizes exactly two critical points, gives a uniform curvature zone and a normalized F away gap greater than 1/12. For W=e^{-y}F on 0<=y<=1, the formal shape constants are C0=81 and C1=36. In the 1:2 slice, the exact caustic has radius between 1/4 and 1/2, while the general contract occupies the strictly interior disk |z|<=1/8.
analyticClaims: For F_y(phi)=cos(phi)+sum Re(beta_m(y) exp(i m phi)), Q2<=1/2 implies Q1<=1/4 and every critical point lies within pi/12 of 0 or pi.
A pi/12 neighborhood of either critical point lies inside the pi/6 curvature zone, where |F_y''| is at least mu=(sqrt(3)-1)/2.
The normalized F away gap exceeds 1/12; for W=e^{-y}F on 0<=y<=1, the declared Coble--He shape contract is (r,C0,C1)=(pi/12,81,36).
For F(phi)=cos(phi)+Re(z exp(2 i phi)), the exact degenerate-critical-point locus is z(phi)=exp(-3 i phi)/8-3 exp(-i phi)/8.
The same caustic satisfies (|z|^2-1/16)^3=(27/1024)(Im z)^2 and 1/4<=|z|<=1/2; every phase ray has one wall radius in that interval.
In the 1:2 slice Q2=4|z|, so Q2<=1/2 is the disk |z|<=1/8, strictly inside the arbitrary-phase caustic-free disk |z|<1/4.
finiteDiagnostics: Every plotted curve is a direct sample of an exact formula.
The sampled curves cannot replace the continuous proof.
No PDE evolution, root fit, regression, interpolation, or inferred exponent is run.
Runtime producer, independent, and formal crosscheck files gate lineage and are not plotted as mathematical evidence.
Temporary or unsealed crosschecks are rejected.
The canonical certificate directory is flat, symlink-free, and exactly sealed by its sorted SHA256SUMS ledger.
Formal plot and manifest runs reject tracked or staged drift and bind all package sources to Git blobs.

panelClaims.A: The exact 1:2 caustic does not intersect the open disk |z|<1/4 and surrounds the smaller |z|<=1/8 general-contract slice.
panelClaims.B: The exact caustic parametrization gives a unique wall radius on every phase ray, between 1/4 and 1/2.
panelClaims.C: The fixed-M Q2 contract gives critical localization pi/12, curvature zone pi/6, mu=(sqrt(3)-1)/2, normalized F away gap greater than 1/12, and formal W constants C0=81 and C1=36.

claimBoundary: The result is restricted to fixed M, Q2<=1/2, arbitrary static relative phases, and the declared heat-weighted slow-time path. It does not provide constants uniform in growing M, cover arbitrary fast phase modulation or arbitrary common-band carrier geometry, or imply general three-dimensional Navier--Stokes regularity.
